programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: "Mega Marine Machines" brings viewers inside the most demanding marine operations on the planet, where powerful machines and skilled crews are pushed to their limits. Across oceans, rivers and working coastlines, each episode follows professionals using science, engineering and advanced technology to solve real-world problems on the water. With rare access to ships, shipyards and marine environments, the series reveals how critical decisions are made under pressure. As challenges unfold, the science behind the machines becomes clear, delivering meaningful insights through action-driven storytelling. The result is a forward-looking exploration of how humans are building, operating and innovating on the oceans and waterways of a changing world.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: From deep-sea danger to mega holiday cruises, helping rivers flow and harvesting power, "Mega Marine Machines" goes deep, unlocking the ultimate challenges of our water planet. Every mystery of the sea, every danger, every unknown, is a technological challenge waiting to be overcome. Today adventurers, explorers, and fortune seekers are drawn more than ever before to the ocean. Our audience will travel the depth and breadth of our oceans in every gritty fast-paced episode - where cool new tools and technology are pushing the limits in an unforgiving, watery world.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Miami intercept a boat suspected of smuggling narcotics. After a destructive search, they find over 500 kilos of cocaine concealed in the cabin. Meanwhile, in Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents launch an operation on a major highway they suspect is being used by cartels to smuggle drugs, money and people. Off the coast of Florida, agents patrol a route popular with smugglers bringing in contraband from the Bahamas.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Fort Lauderdale are on the hunt for a large shipment of drugs leaving the U.S. With the help of the U.S Coast Guard, they successfully intercept a boat found to be carrying 10 pounds of marijuana. In Gulfport, Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents police the I-10, a notorious smuggling route. Meanwhile, agents patrol the waters for smugglers bringing in illicit goods under the cover of darkness.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TAM Airlines Flight #3054 Airbus A320 July 17th, 2007 - TAM Airlines Flight #3054 is on its final approach to Sao Paulo's notorious Congonhas Airport. Runway 35-L at Congonhas is one of the most treacherous in the world. It's built on a hilltop, surrounded by tall buildings. The crew of Flight #3054 gets a report that the runway is wet and slippery. Captain Henrique Stephanini brings his Airbus A-320 down at the foot of the 1,945 meter long runway, activates the one working thrust reverser and applies the brakes, but his plane doesn't slow down. It hurtles down the runway at top speed, crosses a highway and slams into a building and adjacent gas station. No one on the plane survives. 12 people on the ground are also killed. This is the worst aviation disaster in South American history. Investigators are under enormous pressure to figure out what went wrong on one of Brazil's busiest runways, before it claims any more lives.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 McDonnell Douglas DC-9-82 (MD-82) August 16th, 2005 - Hours behind schedule, West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 finally takes off from Panama City en route to Martinique. The aircraft flies toward weather so severe that the pilots must divert to avoid it. In addition to the turbulence, the pilots have another problem; their engines are not providing enough thrust. To solve this issue the pilots drop down to a lower altitude, but before they can reach it a Stall Warning fills the cockpit. The plane is flying too slowly to remain airborne. Before the pilots can figure out what has caused the problem, the aircraft drops from the sky and crashes on a remote Venezuelan farm. By far the worst aviation disaster in the country's history, a small team of Venezuelan investigators must now determine what brought down one of the safest airplanes in the world.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Delta Flight 191 departs Fort Lauderdale for Dallas-Fort Worth on Aug. 2, 1985. As the aircraft prepared to land, the crew flew into a rapidly intensifying storm, where an unforeseen downburst turned their routine landing into a catastrophe. The crew struggled for control of the plane, but the sudden impact of the downburst made a safe landing impossible. Striking a highway, Delta 191 crashes short of the runway, killing 137 people. In this episode, survivors give chilling firsthand accounts of the final moments onboard. This episode reveals how the disaster led to meteorological breakthroughs in understanding microbursts and improvements in weather reporting at airports.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: 12 August, 1985 saw the deadliest single-aircraft accident in aviation history. Japan Airlines Flight 123 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight carrying 524 people from Tokyo to Osaka. Just 12 minutes into the flight, the Boeing 747 jumbo-jet suffered a fatal decompression that ripped off most of the tail. With a total loss of hydraulics, the crew were unable to control the aircraft which tragically crashed into a mountainside. This episode features the account of a widowed partner of one passenger who perished in the crash, on why the grief from the tragedy still lives on..

programme.title: Is It Real?
programme.desc: Do you believe in hauntings? Since time immemorial, people have believed in the dead returning from the grave to haunt the living. But ""haunting"" itself is not a technical term. Its a general description of a paranormal phenomenon usually recurring in one particular location. A haunting can incorporate ghosts, poltergeists, demonic possession…and really anything else that gives you the heebie-geebies. But are hauntings real? We examine three cases from around the world to see if science can explain what so many believers cannot. First, we head to Long Island and the famous case, which led to ""The Amityville Horror"" its the story of the Lutzes, who move into their dream house at 112 Ocean Avenue, only to find themselves running for their lives just 28 days later. But was this a real horror story or just a hoax? Next, we go to Wilder, Kentucky, to a supposedly haunted country and western bar Bobby Mackeys Music World complete with a mechanical bull…that is believed to turn on without power. Can science hoe down with the supernatural in this haunted honky tonk? Finally, we conduct our own experiment on hauntings by filming ghost enthusiasts who have agreed to spend the night in what is supposedly one of the most haunted places in the United Kingdom: Muncaster Castle. Will they even make it through the night? With psychologists Jason Braithwaite and Jim Houran, we will conduct tests on electromagnetic energy, carbon monoxide and infrasound to see if science can explain what many of us see when the lights go out. Join us in an intriguing investigation at the crossroads of science and the supernatural, with results that just might scare you to death.

programme.title: Is It Real?
programme.desc: Mishima in Mexico draws inspiration from Yukio Mishima's novel Thirst for Love and from Mishima's legacy as it is encountered today within a global queer context. The original novel is a twisted romance set in 1950s post-war Japan. Etsuko, a widowed society woman falls in love with her servant Saburo, a rural farm boy, but her desire drives them both to tragedy. In collaboration with Alex Segade, Tsang's stripped down adaptation is set in a single room of an iconic hotel in Mexico City. A writer and director struggle to relate through the creative process, while on-screen as Etsuko and Saburo, they shift in and out of mutable characters. In this experimental narrative, the liminal space between reality and fantasy for the performer becomes fluid and the separation between observer and observed starts to collapse.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Police closed the case of the infamous Boston Strangler when handyman Albert De Salvo confessed to the grisly murder of 13 women. But recent forensic evidence reveals that in at least one of the murders - and possibly all of them - police may have had the wrong man. Some even theorize that the strangler may be walking free today. Now, the National Geographic Channel investigates in The Hunt for the Boston Strangler.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. Yet decades after the fact, certain stories remain touched by an air of uncertainty. Investigate the truth behind some of history's greatest events and most iconic people. Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: Russia's Mystery Files
programme.desc: The old Soviet Union was a sinister world, a land of secrets, rumours and uncertainty. Now the Iron Curtain has fallen, and we can investigate these rumours - from mountain wild-men to terrifying zombie dogs to a profoundly mysterious incident on the Mountain of the Dead. Eyewitness testimony and powerful point-of-view dramatic reconstructions will bring these extraordinary stories to life. ... We will enter a world where nothing is quite as it seems.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: In 1953, a US Army scientist working on biological weapons, Dr. Frank Olson, falls to his death from his hotel window under suspicious circumstances. Almost twenty years later, the US government offers Olson's family a $750,000 pay-out, revealing that he died because of his involvement in a secret CIA experiment studying the use of LSD and interrogation—an offshoot of a series of mind control experiments called MK-ULTRA. Go behind the true extent of these secret CIA experiments and their casualties.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Thord and his young crew battle a blizzard to rescue a truck that blocks one lane of a major road. As traffic speeds past, on a hill that's covered in ice, it's a disaster waiting to happen. In Overhalla, fifth generation rescuer Ole Henrik is not only a partner in the business - he's now a father to three young children. As a result, he's not had much sleep. But when a truck carrying a valuable load of fish for export overturns, he has no choice but to head out and brace himself for an all-nighter. Across the border, in Sweden, local tow-trucker Ludwig calls on Raido to help out, when a box truck carrying medical supplies crashes hard into a snow-covered ditch. Because the truck is pitched nose-down and threatens to tip over, Raido takes a big risk and digs a tunnel beneath the snow, to run a support strap around the truck body.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue
programme.desc: Thord and Bjoern join forces when a truck threatens to tip down a hill. As it teeters on the balance, Bjoern plans to climb a ladder to secure a strap until Thord puts a stop to it. On an iced-up mountain track, Domenic and Thord's daughter, Malin, head out to rescue a van but fail to reach it. Thord joins them on a rescue that makes him realise there's a fine line between life and death. In the north, Jo Roger calls in reinforcements for a triple rescue of a truck, van and drill rig.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In Brazil, David Blaine seeks inspiration by immersing himself in his hosts' vibrant energy, passion and spontaneity. The exceptional daredevils, artists, explorers and athletes he encounters unite to help him bring an audacious feat to life that's lingered in his dreams for years.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In Southeast Asia, David Blaine explores fascinating relationships with wildlife and how pain endurance can transform fear into magic. He meets practitioners who appear impenetrable by sharp objects and performers who can endure the stings of venomous creatures. David unpacks how people exploit fear in order to create wonder.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: As part of a joint effort during Super Bowl LIV, dubbed "Operation Team Player," CBP and HSI seize more than 176,000 counterfeit items, and make multiple arrests related to human trafficking and drug smuggling. HSI Atlanta conducts a controlled delivery of a hollowed-out truck battery filled with 5 kilos of heroin. And HSI New York tracks a suspected drug courier, a.k.a. "Busy Bee", who is found to have pellets of cocaine concealed on his person.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Atlanta discovers a suitcase left in the airport by its owner, which contains cocaine concealed in coffee bags. Suspecting a trend, officers begin blitzing flights from the source country and make a second arrest. CBP Miami investigates a series of wildlife trafficking crimes, including an elderly man suspected of smuggling birds to the US in his pants; and a shipment of more than 1400 turtle shell fragments that were forcibly removed from an endangered species. HSI New York arrests a suspected cocaine smuggler who works at JFK and uncovers information that takes-down an entire drug-trafficking ring.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. At the Fort Lauderdale Airport, U.S. Customs and Border Protection seizes over a thousand hydrocodone pills from an airline pilot returning from Colombia. At Atlanta International Airport, CBP consults with archaeologists to verify the authenticity of several artifacts they suspect were looted.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: A hurricane sets two vastly different species on a collision course off the coast of North Carolina when a group of surfers paddle into waters patrolled by one of Earth's most ancient and deadly marine animals. And in Fort Collins, Colorado, a trail runner's training session devolves into hand-to-hand combat with a stealthy, heavily-armed mammal.

programme.title: Song of the Rainforest
programme.desc: China's Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park is a breathtaking biodiversity hotspot where flora and fauna compete and coexist in a delicate dance of survival. This unique location — an island with soaring 1800-meter peaks — has created an environment where plants and animals have evolved in relative isolation from the mainland to live together. The rare Hainan black-crested gibbon, one of the rarest mammals on Earth, sustains the forest by dispersing seeds far and wide in its poop. Weaver ants wage war in the canopy, building homes and finding scorpions to snack on. Pointed-scale pit vipers lurk in the underbrush while shrews and other rodents scramble to find fruit and other morsels that have dropped from the canopy.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: In the Costa Rican jungle, a sudden strike turns a television producer's location scout into a race to save his leg and possibly his life. And in Orange County, California, a personal trainer becomes the second victim of an apex predator stalking the mountain trails. When her ex-marine combat skills aren't enough to drive off her attacker, a pack of mountain bikers comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa the Wild Side Updates
programme.desc: Eye-catching animals steal the show with charm, charisma, and cuteness! At Zoo Tampa, the orangutan family adjusts to life with a new baby. A giraffe conquers her fears and becomes the star of her herd, and staff anxiously awaits a new joey from the resident koala couple. From an adorable puzzle-solving bear to a hilarious elephant enrichment, —there's no denying some animals, are stars!

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa Compilation
programme.desc: Buckle up for an exciting adventure across the plains of Africa — Zoo Tampa style! In this action-packed episode, African animals take center stage as the zoo welcomes its first female giraffe, elephant intelligence and cooperation are put to the test, and a new rhino calf is born.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa Compilation
programme.desc: Fall in love with the Asian and Australian animals of Zoo Tampa! In this special episode, a sun bear has a date with the dentist, a duo of clouded leopards explores their new habitat, the zoo says goodbye to a beloved koala, and a pair of rhinos make a love connection.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant on a getaway weekend suffers a very uncivilized fate. Ambushed by a hungry animal, he goes toe to toe with his attacker to save himself and his dogs.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Water shapes northern Argentina, creating paradises for unique wildlife. Whether it's sooty swifts swooping through waterfall floodwaters, frogs glowing in the dark, cute coati families in the undergrowth, or mighty anacondas on the prowl. Argentina's wetlands hold many wonders. In magnificent images, the film celebrates Argentina's water-rich north as a hotspot of biodiversity and shows how drought and fires threaten the fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Survival is a daunting proposition. But when the going gets tough, the wild inhabitants morph into oddballs. Millennia of weird evolution have made this giant continent a land of mutants. Expect the unexpected because here, outlandish is the new normal.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. From their very first breath, it's all about one thing for the little ones: survival. Orcas hunt for young sea lions with a special technique and seagulls fly merciless aerial attacks on baby whales. Extraordinary underwater images and impressive animal behavior make the film by Christian Baumeister a visual experience.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Water shapes northern Argentina, creating paradises for unique wildlife. Whether it's sooty swifts swooping through waterfall floodwaters, frogs glowing in the dark, cute coati families in the undergrowth, or mighty anacondas on the prowl. Argentina's wetlands hold many wonders. In magnificent images, the film celebrates Argentina's water-rich north as a hotspot of biodiversity and shows how drought and fires threaten the fragile ecosystem.

Expect the unexpected because here, outlandish is the new normal.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: The Equator runs two thousand five hundred miles across the great continent of Africa. The species that live here are as varied as its landscapes. Giant grazers and iconic carnivores dominate its arid grasslands while rare apes thrive in its rainforests. Here, floods follow famine year after year but the animals have adapted and evolved to make the most of their environments. This is equatorial Africa - cauldron of evolution

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Supersized Sharks
programme.desc: Has a small island in the middle of the South Pacific become a drive-thru burger joint for the world's largest Tiger Sharks? Luring the giants to their boat, shark biologists Lauren Meyers, Charlie Huveneers and Adam Barnette investigate and are surprised to discover that beef is not the only unusual item on the menu.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey into Australia's forests to meet an unforgettable cast of baby animals. Follow koala joeys as they go from tiny pouch-bound newborns to adventurous climbers. Watch flying fox pups grow into skilled young fliers, while kookaburra chicks discover their voices and begin exploring the world beyond the nest. In the rainforests of Queensland, rare tree kangaroo joeys peek out from their mothers' pouches, and striped cassowary chicks learn essential survival skills from one of nature's most dedicated dads. Along the way, discover how possums — and even tiny caterpillars — grow, play and prepare for life on their own. Filled with fascinating wildlife facts, remarkable family stories and stunning natural behavior, this episode reveals the challenges, surprises and milestones that shape the lives of Australia's youngest forest residents.

programme.title: Most Wanted Sharks
programme.desc: There are millions of sharks in our oceans, but a select few are so fascinating, they've become worldwide celebrities. Whether it's the biggest great white, the most photographed tiger shark, or the shark known for jumping 100 feet up out of the water, we're diving into the stories of the greatest shark stars of all time, each with their own legion of social media followers.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Cape Cod — America's Playground — is a newly emerging hotspot for a top predator. Great Whites are appearing in increasing numbers, when for centuries there were none. Through spectacular imagery, we'll see how the landscape of Cape Cod has changed over time, and what is luring Great Whites in record numbers.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Cannibal Sharks
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Cannibal Sharks pulls in two of the world's leading shark experts to unpack and analyze the mounting evidence that shark-on-shark attacks happen a lot more than we ever realized.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Set sail for Australia's extraordinary islands and meet a fascinating cast of baby animals. Follow green sea turtle hatchlings as they race from sandy nests to the ocean, fur seal pups learning to swim along rugged coastlines, and quokka joeys taking their first hops beside their mothers. In Tasmania, feisty Tasmanian devil joeys emerge from the pouch ready to explore. Far to the south on subantarctic Macquarie Island, fluffy king penguin chicks, elephant seal pups and young albatrosses face the challenges of life in a harsh and windswept world. Packed with amazing animal behaviors, surprising wildlife facts and unforgettable family moments, this episode reveals the remarkable journeys that transform Australia's island babies from vulnerable newborns into confident young adventurers.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive. Watch wild brumby foals find their footing in rugged bushland, while peewee chicks, bush stone-curlew chicks and monarch butterfly caterpillars face their own unique challenges on the path to adulthood. From learning what to eat and how to avoid danger to mastering essential skills through play, exploration and family guidance, every youngster must prepare for life on its own. Along the way, witness extraordinary transformations, incredible parenting strategies and surprising survival adaptations found nowhere else in the world.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Darbīga bebra dēļ Celtnieklīcī pazūd elektrība! Lai to atkal pieslēgtu, komandai jāuzceļ vaininiekam jauna mītne. Pilsētas palīgu gājiena dienā Ātrmeistars sabojā ceļu. Suņukiem ar steigu jālabo viņa kaitējums.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.desc: Doras draugi krabīši grasās precēties, bet Garnadzis nočiepj gredzenu un pazaudē to okeānā. Dora dodas to meklēt. Dora un Zābaciņš satiek vikuņu Vikiju, kura pazaudējusi savu burvju flautu un nevar atgriezties Mākoņu valstībā.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: "Blū pavedienos tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū un viņas kopējs Džošs acing skatītājus piedalīties mīklu minēšanas piedzīvojumos. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu šo uzdevumu!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Zobainais, mīlīgais Krokodila kungs kopā ar labāko draudzeni Deiziju bezbēdīgi lavierē pa dzīvi, kas pilna trakiem piedzīvojumiem un komiskiem pārpratumiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais uztvēris melodiju no Marsa. Barbapapas būvē raķeti, lai dotos uz sarkano planētu. Ceļā uz Marsu Barbapapas sastop Barbamarsiešu ģimeni. Viņiem nav laika iepazīties, kad ciemam uzbrūk milzu augs.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais uztvēris melodiju no Marsa. Barbapapas būvē raķeti, lai dotos uz sarkano planētu. Ceļā uz Marsu Barbapapas sastop Barbamarsiešu ģimeni. Viņiem nav laika iepazīties, kad ciemam uzbrūk milzu augs.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija apmaldās izklaides centrā. Tims meklē jaunu, sev piemērotu raķeti. Kad Terija pieskata bērnus, Tims cenšas apiet visus noteikumus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas būt divos pasākumos reizē. Tims meklē Kajai uzkodu bez purvzāles. Pēc vairākiem zaudējumiem Tija cenšas uzvarēt visās ballīšu spēlēs.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: No Piedzīvojumu līča atbrauc Rokijs, lai apciemotu Rabla komandu. Tieši laikā, lai redzētu Celtnieklīča jauno lācēnu! Kad reindžere Roza lūdz palīdzēt ar celtniecību, Ātrmeistars netīšām iznīcina lāču māju. Ķepaiņiem un Rokijam jāglābj situācija.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Gatavojoties Banānu dienai, Gabrielam un Sjerrai Spīdošajai vajag būvnieku palīdzību, tāpēc Rabla komanda ķeras pie darba. Bākuguns vietā Ātrmeistars izgaismo debesis ar savu seju, kad tas nogādā kuģi nepatikšanās, ķepaiņi steidz palīdzēt.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija nevar izlemt, ko dāvināt omītei. Tims uzņem pats savu Kapteiņa Dinozvaigznes filmu. Tims izliekas, lai pierādītu, ka ir tikpat foršs, cik Kajas brālēns.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja sastrīdas un sāk meklēt jaunus labākos draugus.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Salda un garda diena Blū beķerejā, jo Blū un Džošs cep bibinku, Filipīnās iecienītu kūku. Spēlēsim "Blū pavedieni", lai noskaidrotu, kam Blū vēlas cept, un palīdzētu Banānu cepējai lasīt banānus viņas Pērtiķu mafiniem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt. Barbamamma grib, lai barbabērni uzkopj savas istabas. Viņi slēpjas, lai izvairītos no garlaicīgā darba.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīci ir pārņēmis noslēpums. Kad pēkšņi pazūd pilsētnieku skulptūra, Rabla komandai pievienojas Čeiss, lai atrisinātu pazudušās statujas noslēpumu... un uzbūvētu gluži jaunu Zinātnes centru, lai palīdzētu izmeklēt.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Gabriels rīko Talantu šovu, taču Ātrummeistars izdomā plānu, lai viņš būtu vienīgais dalībnieks. Cetnieklīča svētkos dziedās Sjerra Spīdošā, un vajadzīgi jauni instrumenti.

Barbatētis tādēļ nolemj bērniem pastāstīt par to, kā viņš un Lolita reiz devās ekspedīcijā uz Arktiku.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērni pirmoreiz brauks ar vilcienu un nakšņos viesnīcā. Mamma būs ar viņiem, bet tētis atsevišķi vedīs paštaisītos izstrādājumus. Viņiem jāpārdod savi darbiņi ikgadējā lielajā tirdziņā, ja tētis paspēs laicīgi... // Uzsniga sniegs un bērni sarīkoja pikošanos, bet Barbabo uzcēla lielisku sniegavīru. Bet kā lai viņu saglabā, kad paliks siltāks? Sākas sacensības ar laiku...

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Daži dzīvnieki ir biedējoši un šķiet bīstami. Tētis stāsta savu piedzīvojumu, kad viņš ar Lolitu kāpa kalnos un satika vilku. // Rīt ir bērnu pirmā skolas diena, katrs gatavojas citādāk. Pirmā skolas diena ir satraucoša, tik daudz par ko jāpadomā.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.desc: Sveicināti "Blū bistro", ļoti smalkā restorānā! Spēlējot "Blū pavedienus", noskaidrosim, ko Blū vēlas ēst, palīdzēsim Džošam pieņemt mūsu draugu pasūtījumus, kā arī dosimies uz Zemnieka Āža fermu pēc svaigiem dārzeņiem.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Karla pirātu tematikas restorāns nonāk vētrainos ūdeņos, kucēni dodas jūrā ar jaunu būvniecības risinājumu.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora ceļo pa lietusmežu, sacerot dziesmiņu tētim, lai kopā ar viņu nosvinētu Tēta un Doras dienu! Dora ir gatava Čurro fiestai, taču izrādās, ka visus našķus ir apēduši Pirātrukši. Dora dodas meklēt īpašu dārgumu lādi, kurā paslēpti zelta čurro.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora uzzina, ka viņas vecmamma nav svinējusi savus Pieaugšanas svētkus, un sarīko viņai pārsteiguma ballīti ar īpašu kleitu, diadēmu un kurpēm! Doras draugam Koko nav aizraujoša stāsta, ar ko izklaidēt biedrus, tāpēc viņi dodas pie Pastāstu koka!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Victorious tells the story of the sixteen year old Tori Vega. She grows up in the shadow of her older sister Trina, the big star of the family. But this suddenly changes as Tori attends Hollywood Arts, the best high school of performing arts. Soon she finds out that it is difficult to find her way and be accepted by her fellow students. While Tori is a great singer, dancer and actress, she doesn't realise it. Gradually she finds out that she is a true entertainer and very talented.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Max decides to surprise Phoebe on one of her solo missions, only to discover that she has been secretly teaming up with Captain Perfect. When Max hears Captain Perfect discuss his plans for the Thundermans with someone else, he realizes that the mystery supe is keeping a secret from them. After confronting Captain Perfect, the Thundermans are told by him and President Kickbutt that the new supe was sent to Secret Shores to spy on the twins, and to decide whether they should be allowed to stay on their mission. Meanwhile, Chloe's crush invites her to his father's product launch party at Splat By The Sea, at the same time Jinx and Booch want Chloe to protest the wealthy family outside the party. Unable to hurt anyone's feelings, Chloe tries to use her powers to be in two places at once.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Chloe and her friends face the loss of their school clubs after Max uses the funds to buy himself a hallway golf cart. In retaliation, a mystery prankster starts pulling pranks on Max, who declares he will never give in to his new anonymous nemesis. Instead, Max enlists the help of Principal Bradford from Hiddenville, who knows how to deal with pranksters after years of having Max as a student. While Bradford teaches Max how to deal with school pranks, Chloe admits to Phoebe that she is the mystery prankster, and says she will continue the pranks until Max gives up his golf cart and returns the funds to the clubs. Ultimately feeling defeated by the pranks, Max tells Chloe that he can't continue on their Secret Shores mission, and is returning home a defeated man. Chloe panics, and tells Max the truth, only for Max to reveal he already knew, and was trying to get her to admit the truth. Max agrees to return the cart if Chloe stops her campaign of pranks.

The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly is about teenager Carly who produces her own web show named iCarly along with her three friends Freddie, Sam and Gibby. The show is broadcasted from a studio Carly constructed in the flat where she lives with her 29 years old brother and guardian Spencer. While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Victorious tells the story of the sixteen year old Tori Vega. She grows up in the shadow of her older sister Trina, the big star of the family. But this suddenly changes as Tori attends Hollywood Arts, the best high school of performing arts. Soon she finds out that it is difficult to find her way and be accepted by her fellow students. While Tori is a great singer, dancer and actress, she doesn't realise it. Gradually she finds out that she is a true entertainer and very talented.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff."

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Time Out: Kowalski's invention that stops time falls into the worst hands possible. King Julien's. The lemur promptly breaks it trapping the two of them in a world frozen in time. Instead of being a disaster, however, they realize they can do everything their hearts desire invent like crazy, perform on Broadway, play tennis in the middle of the street. But even an infinite playland like this can't last forever! Our Man in Grrfurjiclestan: Special Agent Buck Rockgut makes a "triumphant" return. While hunting the Red Squirrel across the globe, the crusty old bird contacts the penguins with a warning that the diabolical squirrel has a brainwashed sleeper agent among them. They battle each other to a standstill to uncover the agent - will it tear the unit apart? Can trust ever be restored? They have to take a trip to a faraway borough to uncover the truth."

programme.desc: Sonic confronts Nine atop the Citadel and tries to convince him to save the Shatterverse. Nine refuses to listen, blinded by fury. When Nine focuses all his might on Sonic, Sonic's trap is sprung! The endgame is at hand.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. Šajā raidījumā stāstīsim par vēja parku būvniecības ekonomiskajiem ieguvumiem un to, cik svarīga ir sabiedrības līdzdalībaun izglītošana.

programme.desc: Kā saslēgties ar jauno laiku, kas nāk mums pretī un izvirza citus noteikumus? Kā nenodot savas vērtības un tomēr spēt piedalīties ar pilnu spēku? Caur rietumu un austrumu kultūru atšķirībām, nopietnību un veselīgu humoru atbildes uz šiem jautājumiem Margaritas Ziedas lugā "Viss zem debesīm" aicina meklēt režisors Alvis Hermanis ar aktieriem Gunu Zariņu un Vili Daudziņu. (Arhīvs, 2022.gads)

programme.title: Pieslēgums
programme.desc: Raidījumā iezīmēsim Latvijas atjaunīgās enerģijas kopainu, izceļot jautājumus, kurus turpmākajās epizodēs pētīsim sīkāk. Skaidrosim, kāpēc Latvijā aizvien vairāk redzam vēja un saules parkus, un cik "zaļa" patiesībā ir Latvijas enerģētika. Uzklausīsim atšķirīgus viedokļus par vēja ģeneratoru būvniecību, elektroenerģijas izmaksām un Latvijas enerģētisko neatkarību. Meklēsim atbildi uz jautājumu — vai ar atjaunīgajiem resursiem pietiks mūsu arvien augošajām vajadzībām un cik tālu ir laiks, kad nāksies upurēt daļu no ierastajām ērtībām, lai enerģijas pietiktu pamatvajadzībām? Tiksimies ar cilvēkiem, kuri jau šodien ievēro "enerģijas diētu" - attiekušies pārvietoties ar lidmašīnām, ja iespējams, pārvietojas tikai ar sabiedrisko transportu un apkurei izmanto efektīvas pašu būvētas raķeškrāsnis.

programme.title: Latvijas vēsturiskie novadi
programme.desc: Sēlija - jauna un moderna tēma vai sena un aizmirsta? Bet varbūt gan moderna, gan aktuāla. Kā jūtas Latvijas iedzīvotāji, kurus par sēļiem sauc? Cik spēcīga ir viņu identitāte? Kādi plāni un mērķi ir Sēlijas iedzīvotājiem? Raidījuma vadītāji centīsies noskaidrot nezināmo, apstiprināt zināmo un, ļoti iespējams, atklās dažas pavisam nezināmas lietas un vietas pašā noslēpumainākajā Latvijas novadā - Sēlijā.

programme.title: Copes Frekvence
programme.desc: "Copes Frekvence" dodas uz Rāznas ezeru, kur Kārlis kopā ar komandu "NGT Latvia" (Toms Klabis un Gatis Ernstons) aizvada pirmsčempionāta treniņu. Epizodē pētām ezera zivju resursus pirms Latgales atklātā čempionāta spiningošanā no laivām 2026, aizskarot arī svarīgus jautājumus par lielo iekšdedzes dzinēju izmantošanas noteikumiem Rāznā un copes taktiku apstākļos, kad LIVE tehnoloģijas ir aizliegtas.

programme.title: Zaļo domu viktorīna Re, kā!
programme.desc: Zaļo domu viktorīnas "Re, kā!" pirmajā epizodē savā starpā sacentīsies divas spilgtas komandas - "Čehova teātris" un "Nacionālais teātris". Dalībniekiem būs jāatbild uz dažādiem jautājumiem par vidi, ilgtspēju un ikdienas izvēlēm, vienlaikus demonstrējot erudīciju, reakcijas ātrumu un humora izjūtu. Vai teātra cilvēkiem izdosies pārsteigt ar savām zināšanām par zaļo domāšanu?

programme.title: Svētku kūka
programme.desc: Šodienas raidījums ir veltīts īpašiem mirkļiem - tiem, ko atceramies visu mūžu. Un kas gan var būt simboliskāks par kāzu torti - kūku, kas iemieso mīlestību, jaunu sākumu un kopā būšanu. Kāzu torte nav tikai deserts - tā ir svētku centrālais akcents, kas apvieno skaistumu, garšu un emocijas. Šodien parādīsim, kā dekorēt gardu svētku torti, kas būs cienīga jebkurām kāzām. Ilze Kupča Kūciņa pārsteigs ikvienu mājas kūku mīļotāju un pierādīs, ka tas ir iespējams ikvienam! Kopā ar skaisto kāzu torti dosimies ciemos uz īstām Latgaļu kāzām. Tā ir komēdijizrāde "Kāzas Latgalē" - 24 stundu trakākais piedzīvojums jaunā pāra mūžā. Šo grandiozo kāzu vadītājs ir aktieris Imants Strads. Skaidrosim, kādas tad ir īstas Latgaļu kāzas? Un uzzināsim vai aktierim bieži nākas pašam vadīt kāzas? Uzzināsim arī kādu kāzu atgadījumu.

programme.title: Pieslēgums
programme.desc: Vēja enerģija var dot Latvijai lielāku enerģētisko neatkarību un jaunas ekonomiskās iespējas. Mēģināsim saprast, kā sadalās ieguvumi un iespējamie zaudējumi. Noskaidrosim, kā tiek izraudzītas vietas vēja parkiem, kurš pieņem lēmumus par to būvniecību un kādas iespējas vietējiem iedzīvotājiem ir šos lēmumus ietekmēt. Raidījumā pētīsim, cik nozīmīga Latvijas energoapgādē jau šobrīd ir vēja enerģija un cik daudz tās mums vajadzētu nākotnē. Runāsim ar vēja parku attīstītājiem, pašvaldību pārstāvjiem, vides ekspertiem un cilvēkiem, kuru ikdienu šie projekti ir mainījuši. Viesosimies pie lauksaimnieka, kurš piekritis vēja turbīnas būvniecībai uz savas zemes, un uzklausīsim arī tos, kuri pret vēja parku ienākšanu savā apkārtnē iebilst.

programme.title: Latvijas stāsti
programme.desc: "Augustes iedvesmas dārzs" ir neparasta vieta Saulkrastu novada Sējas pagastā, kur aizrautīgi saimnieko Laura Dance. Vispirms jau dārzs ir iedvesmas avots pašai Laurai. Aizejot no darba, kas vairs nesniedza piepildījumu, un meklējot nodarbošanos, kas iepriecinātu, viņa saprata, ka vēlētos strādāt dārzā. Un tiklīdz šī doma izteikta skaļi, radās arī iespēja to īstenot. Pirmie gadi dārzā aizvadīti smagi strādājot, mācoties, eksperimentējot, vienlaikus priecājoties par paveikto un kaļot arvien jaunus plānus, lai Latvijā būtu par vienu skaistu vietu vairāk.

programme.desc: Katru darba dienu kopā ar dažādu nozaru speciālistiem, kā arī "Delfi" un citu mediju žurnālistiem aicinām skatītājus spriest par kādu aktuālu tematu - politiķu lēmumiem un to sekām, amatpersonu rīcību un tās motīviem, pārmaiņām sabiedrībā un tās virzītām iniciatīvām, pasaulē notiekošo un tā ietekmi uz Latviju, sasniegumiem un zaudējumiem sportā, kultūras personībām un procesiem.

programme.title: Kas ir īsts?!
programme.desc: Mūsdienu informācijas pārbagātībā robeža starp patiesību un izdomājumiem kļūst arvien trauslāka, padarot mūs ievainojamus pret dažādām manipulācijām. Raidījums "Kas ir īsts!" kopā ar autorēm Lauru un Annu piedāvā praktisku un ikvienam saprotamu ceļvedi dezinformācijas džungļos. Mēs skaidrosim, kā neiekrist mākslīgā intelekta ģenerēto attēlu slazdos un ar ekspertu palīdzību mācīsimies pamanīt vizuālas viltojuma pēdas. Raidījumā analizēsim, kā atmaskot emocionāli "uzlādētus" virsrakstus un kā pārbaudīt ziņu ticamību, pievēršot uzmanību avotiem un autoriem. Ielūkosimies sociālo tīklu algoritmu un informācijas "burbuļu" aizkulisēs, kā arī kopā ar psihologu meklēsim atbildes, kāpēc cilvēki notic meliem un kā par to cieņpilni runāt ar tuviniekiem. Apskatīsim dezinformāciju gan kā hibrīdkara ieroci un vēlēšanu ietekmēšanas rīku, gan kā ikdienišķu krāpniecību ģimenes sarakstēs un telefona zvanos. Mēs ne tikai identificēsim draudus, bet sniegsim konkrētus soļus, kā rīkoties, kur ziņot un kā pasargāt sevi un savus mīļos.

programme.desc: Māris Olte kopā ar upju atbrīvotājiem jauks bebru dambi - praktiski ieteikumi, kāpēc un kā to darīt! Raidījumā "Meža veča emuāri" skaidrosim kādas ir upju attīrīšanas fokusa aktivitātes un ko tās uzlabo upes tecējumā, un vai uzlabo krastos esošo mežaudzi. #MAF #mežaatbalstafonds

programme.title: Tiksimies stacijā!
programme.desc: 19.⁠ ⁠gadsimta beigās, atšķirībā no Rīgas un Liepājas, uz Ventspils ostu dzelzceļa vēl nebija. Ar investīcijām tādu būvēt nāca privātā Ribinskas dzelzceļa sabiedrība. Līniju Ventspils-Maskava būvēja pa posmiem. Pirmos iecirkņus, arī no Tukuma līdz Ventspilij, atklāja 1901. gadā, bet starp Jelgavu un Krustpili - 1904 . Latvijas teritorijā dzelzceļa garums ir 456 km. Šī satiksme kalpoja lauksaimniecības produktu pārvadāšanai, piemēram, iecienīts bija Sibīrijas sviests, arī naftas produktiem un, protams, neiztikt bez pasažieriem. Diemžēl 2000. gadā pasažieru satiksmi starp Jelgavu un Krustpili pārtrauca. Kas noticis ar staciju ēkām? Šai reizē iegriezīsimies Garozā, no kuras savulaik bija izbūvēts arī šaursliežu atzars. Vērsim Iecavas stacijas ēkas durvis un uzzināsim Misas stāstus. #SIF_MAF2026

programme.title: Līdaku ielenktie
programme.desc: ReTV ar prieku piedāvā skatītājiem pirmo Latvijā tapušo dokumentālo piedzīvojumu TV seriālu makšķerniekiem! Tas būs saistošs gan mūsu lielajai copmaņu komūnai, gan arī dabas piedzīvojumu cienītājiem. Seriālā atspoguļotas sešu pieredzējušu piedzīvojumu meklētāju-makšķernieku gaitas, pirmo reizi dodoties ar mašīnām un jumta teltīm Norvēģijas virzienā, meklējot tās mazskartajos ūdeņos līdakas, foreles un citas zivis. Pirms došanās ceļā pavadītas daudz stundas, rūpīgi pētot kartes, ūdeņus, makšķernieku forumus Latvijā un Novēģijā, kā arī ievācot informāciju no tiem retajiem Latvijas makšķerniekiem, kas pabijuši Norvēģijas iekšzemes ūdeņos, meklējot līdakas un citas zivis. Salikts plāns, kura viena no stabilākajām un nemainīgajām lietām ir… pārmaiņas, pielāgošanās apstākļiem, nezināmajam un neparedzamajam. 10 dienās džeki saskārās gan ar copi, gan necopi, gan izmisumu, gan plānu maiņu, gan viegliem, gan grūtiem lēmumiem un visu citu, kas piestāv šādam ceļojumam.

programme.title: Dzīvīte
programme.desc: Raidījumā tiks apskatītas dažādas tēmas un noskaidrotas atbildes uz neskaidriem sadzīves jautājumiem, piemēram, juridiskas dabas vai par sociāliem pakalpojumiem. Sadarbībā ar vadošo ārstniecības iestāžu speciālistiem tiks stāstīts arī par medicīnas aktualitātēm, veselību un veselīgu dzīvesveidu, kā arī citām svarīgām lietām.

programme.title: Nolaid slieksni!
programme.desc: Raidījuma cikla "Nolaid slieksni" astotajā epizodē iepazīstam Mārīti Alvateri - vizuālā tēla stilisti un divu bērnu mammu. Mārītes ikdiena ir nemitīga pienākumu plānošana un līdzsvara meklēšana starp darbu, bērnu vajadzībām, skolas gaitām, pulciņiem un rūpēm par ģimeni. Pēc attiecību izjukšanas viņa lielākoties viena uzņēmusies atbildību par bērnu ikdienu, saskaroties arī ar finansiālām grūtībām un citiem dzīves pārbaudījumiem. Mārītes stāsts atklāj solo vecāka ikdienas izaicinājumus un to, cik svarīgi ir spēt organizēt savu laiku un resursus, lai līdzās rūpēm par ģimeni varētu turpināt strādāt, būt klātesošai bērnu dzīvē un neaizmirst arī par sevi. Kā saglabāt līdzsvaru starp vecāka pienākumiem, profesionālo dzīvi un personīgajām vajadzībām? "Nolaid slieksni" aicina ieraudzīt arī tos šķēršļus, kas nav fiziski, bet veidojas sabiedrības priekšstatu un stereotipu dēļ.

programme.title: Ventas balss
programme.desc: Oktobrī notika pirmais Ventspils iedzīvotāju forums "Ventspils, kā mums te iet?" Tajā pulcējās cilvēki, kuri vēlējās izteikt savu viedokli vai atrast domubiedrus. Ventspilnieki sprieda par to, ko varētu pilnveidot dažādās jomās un arī dažādās apkaimēs, īpaši koncentrējoties uz to, ko iedzīvotāji paši var darīt kopā ar kaimiņiem vai domubiedriem. Kā teica viens no aktīvajiem ventspilniekiem: "Kopīgs darbs ir kopīgs spēks".

programme.title: Ceļot bez robežām
programme.desc: Šovasar izbaudi dažādas pasaules valstis un kultūras kopā ar "Ceļot bez robežām"! Sezonas laikā būs iespēja iepazīt krāšņo Indiju un tās senās tradīcijas, tempļus un kontrastus, redzēt vienu no septiņiem pasaules brīnumiem, kā arī atklāt Šrilankas dabas bagātības un vietējo iedzīvotāju dzīvesveidu. Tāpat ciemosimies sākumskoliņā, ko pēc cunami atjaunoja par latviešu saziedotajiem līdzekļiem. Bet Amerikas Savienotās Valstis pārsteigs ar savu plašumu, pasakaini skaistiem kanjoniem, kā arī tiks piedzīvotas kārtīgas lietus gāzes tuksnesīgajā pilsētā Lasvegasā. Ceļojums turpināsies Eiropā, viesojoties Evijas salā, kur skatītāji iepazīs tās dabas burvību, atklājot vairākas skaistas pludmales. Bet sezonas noslēgumā apmeklēsim "Tropical Islands" parku Vācijā - vienu no lielākajiem iekštelpu tropu kūrortiem Eiropā, kur iespējams izbaudīt vasaru jebkurā gadalaikā.

programme.title: Āzija
programme.desc: Volgas reģiona un Melnās jūras Ziemeļu reģiona vāciešus sauc par "cilvēkiem ceļā". 19.gadsimtā viņi tika izsūtīti uz Vidusāziju. Mazajā Kirgizstānas pilsētiņā Talasā to bija vairāk nekā 100 tūkstoši. Viņi veidoja vācu apmetnes nomadu tautu teritorijā.

programme.title: Praktiski vesels
programme.desc: Netēlo supervaroni! Kā palīdzēt sev un pasargāt citus vīrusu sezonā? Kāpēc rudenī un ziemā slimojam biežāk, ko darīt, ja jūtam pirmos saaukstēšanās simptomus, un kad tomēr lanāk doties pie ārsta - skaties un uzzini! Kopā ar raidījuma vadītājām - veselības vēstnesi Artu Lāci un ginekoloģi, dzemdību speciālisti Karlīnu Elksni - pieredzē un padomos dalās sertificēta "Mēness aptiekas" farmaceite, Latvijas Farmaceitu biedrības valdes locekle Ērika Pētersone un VCA ķirurģiskās klīnikas "AIWA Clinics" otolaringoloģe Jekaterina Kondratiško.

programme.title: Latvijas stāsti
programme.desc: "Augustes iedvesmas dārzs" ir neparasta vieta Saulkrastu novada Sējas pagastā, kur aizrautīgi saimnieko Laura Dance. Vispirms jau dārzs ir iedvesmas avots pašai Laurai. Aizejot no darba, kas vairs nesniedza piepildījumu, un meklējot nodarbošanos, kas iepriecinātu, viņa saprata, ka vēlētos strādāt dārzā. Un tiklīdz šī doma izteikta skaļi, radās arī iespēja to īstenot. Pirmie gadi dārzā aizvadīti smagi strādājot, mācoties, eksperimentējot, vienlaikus priecājoties par paveikto un kaļot arvien jaunus plānus, lai Latvijā būtu par vienu skaistu vietu vairāk.
